00145 inline float zap(float x) throw()
00146 {
00147     float absx = std::abs(x);
00148     return (absx > (float)1e-15 && absx < (float)1e15) ? x : 0.f;
00149 }

00151 inline double besselI0(double p) throw()
00152 {
00153     static const int ITERLIMIT=15;
00154     static const double CONVERGE=1.0E-8;
00155     
00156     p = p/2;
00157     double n = 1, t = 1, d = 1;
00158     int k = 1;
00159     double v;
00160     
00161     do {
00162         n = n * p;           d = d * k;
00163         v = n / d;           t = t + v * v;
00164     } while ((++k < ITERLIMIT) && (v > CONVERGE));
00165     
00166     return t;
00167 }

00213 {
00214     union { int asInt[2]; double asDouble; } n;
